headline: Woman seen with Tahsif in CCTV footage arrested, police seek 7-day remand

members.title: Woman seen with Tahsif in CCTV footage arrested, police seek 7-day remand
members.lead: The River Police have sought a seven-day remand for a woman arrested in connection with the murder case of former Bangladesh Air Force Flight Lieutenant KM Tahsif Souri. CCTV footage showed the 19-year-old girl with Tahsif in an area of the capital on the day he went missing. Today, Sunday, Inspector Firoz Uddin of the Tongi River Police Outpost, the investigation officer in the case, applied to take the woman into seven-day remand. Shamsuddoha Sumon, a lawyer representing the state, confirmed the information. .'My son was trained in swimming; he could not have drowned': Tahsif's father. The remand application states that CCTV footage showed the woman with Tahsif Souri at a restaurant in Uttara on the night of 27 October. They later visited several other places. They also spoke to each other over mobile phones. Police said the remand application had been made to verify statements given during questioning by Ahmed Shahriar Reza Dwip, a ‘younger friend’ of Tahsif. .Tahsif murder case: ‘Younger friend’ Dwip placed on 4-day remand. The woman was arrested from the Kafrul area at around 2:00 am early on Sunday. Dwip was placed on a four-day remand for questioning on Saturday. Tahsif went missing after leaving home at the invitation of Dwip on the evening of 27 October. His body was recovered by the River Police from the Rajbari Ghat area of the Turag River the following afternoon. On Friday night, his father, KM Eneyetul Karim, filed a murder case over his son's death, against unidentified persons with Uttarkhan Police Station in the capital.
